findings.statement: Conversational restrictions read by the Claude classifier can be lost if compaction removes their source message.
findings.limits: This is a documented classifier boundary, not a proof that deny rules mediate every effect or preserve semantic intent.
findings.contradictory_evidence: The narrower interface/host/queue scope in limits prevents a universal control or authority claim. No contrary primary result established in this audit.
findings.decisive_test: Retain durable restrictions and inject compaction/revocation before a tool request.

findings.statement: Gemini policy ask_user decisions become denial in non-interactive operation.
findings.limits: Bind the exact execution mode and policy/schema; this does not imply every interactive host or extension has identical behavior.
findings.contradictory_evidence: The narrower interface/host/queue scope in limits prevents a universal control or authority claim. No contrary primary result established in this audit.
findings.decisive_test: Exercise the same requested action under explicit interactive/headless policies and verify truthful refusal.

findings.statement: Pi RPC abort leaves queued messages eligible to continue; documented interactive Escape composition clears the queue first.
findings.limits: This describes queued steering/follow-up semantics, not external-effect settlement. The recorded repository pin is documentation, not an installed build.
findings.contradictory_evidence: The narrower interface/host/queue scope in limits prevents a universal control or authority claim. No contrary primary result established in this audit.
findings.decisive_test: Queue steering and follow-up work, compare abort alone with clear_queue then abort, and verify retained user input and effect uncertainty.

findings.statement: Hermes busy-input interrupt redirects the turn and can move a foreground terminal command into background; /stop is a separate operation.
findings.limits: Applies to the documented Enter-submitted busy-input path; it is not a universal claim about Ctrl+C, all tools or all descendants.
findings.contradictory_evidence: The narrower interface/host/queue scope in limits prevents a universal control or authority claim. No contrary primary result established in this audit.
findings.decisive_test: Run a disposable scoped foreground operation in a later authorized probe and inspect background ownership and Stop receipts.

findings.statement: The documented Hermes Buzz ACP host can answer approval requests programmatically despite Hermes manual approval configuration.
findings.limits: Host-specific behavior, not all ACP clients. The documented timeout/error path denies. Attribute the actual approving principal.
findings.contradictory_evidence: The narrower interface/host/queue scope in limits prevents a universal control or authority claim. No contrary primary result established in this audit.
findings.decisive_test: Compare an explicit prompting host with the documented auto-answer path using a synthetic approval request; do not execute an effect merely to test display.

unrefreshed_comparisons: Other Codex, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode and Hermes orientation claims overlap earlier Mark 2 evidence or remain companion proposals; this audit does not recertify their entire feature matrices.
Pi remains a reference mechanism, not an added launch-critical integration.
The conceptual separation of result, working relationship and authority is a design proposal; it does not mandate additional forms.
limitations: Primary pages were opened; parent checked consequential passages and retrieved byte digests. Pi documentation is pinned; other pages remain mutable retrieval receipts.
No harness installation, account login, provider trial, model experiment or performance measurement occurred.
The companion contains private local paths. Only publication-safe findings, exact Owner passages already supplied in the handoff and the input digest are retained.
